case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO(S).1706 OF 2023; WITH CIVIL APPEAL NO(S).8323 OF 2022; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S).8132 OF 2022
summary: Resolution Plan validity over trademark rights ownership; CoC approval 81.39% binding; NCLT order declaring corporate debtor own trademarks upheld; NCLAT error in treating trademark declaration as Plan modification; jurisdiction under Sections 60(5)/238 IBC affirmed; Embassy Property precedent distinguished; Resolution Plan interpretation vs alteration analysis; exclusive right to use vs ownership determination.
legal_provisions_cited: IBBI (Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons) Regulations, 2016 Reg.39
Embassy Property Developments Pvt Ltd v. State of Karnataka (2020) 13 SCC 308
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; NCLAT judgment set aside; NCLT ownership declaration upheld; Resolution Plan implementation directed.
